description.zh: App信息，代表一个业务配置
description.en: App information representing a business configuration.

description.zh: ID排序规则，支持asc-正序（最新数据在后）和desc-倒序（最新数据在前）
description.en: ID sort order. Use asc for ascending order (latest data last) or desc for descending order (latest data first).
Page number for paging. Starts from 1.
Number of items per page for paging.

description.zh:
任务业务状态，已过期和已取消的任务不支持查询：
- 1: 等待执行
- 2:  执行中
- 3:  成功
- 4：失败

不传默认查询全部状态
description.en:
Task business status. Expired and canceled tasks cannot be queried:

- 1: Waiting

- 2: Running

- 3: Success

- 4: Failed

If not specified, all statuses are queried by default.

description.zh: 任务UUID，提交对应视频生成任务时返回的TaskUuid。
description.en: Task UUID returned when you submitted the corresponding video generation task.

description.zh: 租户ID，从虚拟数字人开放平台中获取的TenantId
description.en: Tenant ID. Get the TenantId from the Digitized Virtual Human Open Platform.

description.zh: 要检索的视频任务标题，长度<10字符
description.en: Video task title to retrieve. The title must be fewer than 10 characters.

description.zh:

description.en:
Task type:

- 1: 3D digitized virtual human video synthesis.

title.zh: 查询视频合成任务列表

descriptions.zh: 支持根据数字人类型、状态、标题进行筛选。已过期和已取消任务不支持查询。
descriptions.en: You can filter tasks by digitized virtual human type, status, or title. Expired or canceled tasks cannot be queried.
